Keywords: Ivan merchants weighing and church ties
RagShortTexts: Novgorod merchant associations link churches and weighing.
Membership and shared resources influence trading credit.

Variants.Content: Novgorod’s Ivan merchant association links church ties, weighing and common affairs. Members draw on contacts and shared resources, but must still deliver sound goods. Disputes involve buyers and other urban authorities; standing depends on regular performance.
Escorts identify owners and receivers; an association’s name does not weigh cargo. A lost parcel may involve several partners, making witnessed handover valuable.
An association can coordinate weighing and purchases, but officials must identify participating members. Assuming every member guarantees a debt damages subsequent cooperation.
Merchants weigh and inspect goods and seek buyers, using church and fellow-trader contacts as witnesses. Reputation does not remove losses for bad goods; debts travel through familiar networks.
